issues.title: Ex-prosecutor’s killing puts Guatemala’s crime-politics nexus back in focus
issues.title_en: Ex-prosecutor’s killing puts Guatemala’s crime-politics nexus back in focus
issues.summary: GUATEMALA CITY, Oct 22 - Former Guatemalan anti-corruption prosecutor Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa was one of the country's most high profile voices denouncing alleged links between politicians and business leaders and the country's increasingly powerful organized crime groups. Read more at straitstimes.com.
